key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (itraconazole, clarithromycin, nelfinavir, nefazodone)
key_interactions.effect: Higher ivabradine levels; worse bradycardia and conduction disturbances (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (diltiazem, verapamil); grapefruit juice
CYP3A4 inducers (rifampicin, barbiturates, phenytoin, St John's wort)
